audit.title: Imperial Church order 27 Alexandria mechanical map/objective audit
filesRead: docs/design/odysseys/imperial-church.json (episode order 27 and matching episodeBlueprints entry)
audit.scope: Mechanical identity, requirement, resource, frame, and geometric object/zone review. No history, terrain, drainage, native-navigation, or gameplay approval.
method: Applied tools/design/geography.py tile_point to each hub coordinate using the stored WGS84 bbox and map size 400.
Checked SVG transform with renderer factor 650/(400-1), origin (55,85), and tile frame 0..399.
Computed centers, radii, offsets, full corridor-width bounds, actor point collisions, zone coincidences, and player-UI clipping from JSON and SVG geometry.
Checked each objective requirement kind/id/entity list/destination/payment against the described sequence, survivorGroups, and difficulty budget fields.
Scanned current screen text for compacted number punctuation and visible internal IDs.
limits: SVG contains no rendered modern water-control segments, although mapPlan lists modern shoreline/river control sources. Water-distance checking is therefore not possible from this SVG.
No visible water lines is not evidence of dry land; no ancient land mask, terrain raster, dated shoreline, or native pathfinding is supplied here.
Static resource arithmetic is not a playthrough or native runtime verification.

mainIdentityComposition.historicalMaterialPolicy: The two notes and timeline are fictional/local retrospective working records, not original imperial letters. The household IDs are fictional voluntary households, not historical bishops.

o2.requirement: o2/req-1: all three western household IDs arrive at destination-2; all three eastern household IDs arrive at destination-3.
o2.funding: o2/req-3: once-only 180 food and 120 wood, split 90 food + 60 wood to each host (destinations 2 and 3).
o2.assessment: Each cohort receives its own separate host receipt; the other cohort's destination cannot satisfy it.

o3.funding: o3/req-5: once-only 240 food and 120 wood, split 120 food + 60 wood to each onward court (destinations 5 and 6).
o3.assessment: Each ordered departure is linked to its own cohort's prior o2 receipt; each arrival is linked to its own o3 departure and mapped to its own onward destination. Early arrival does not satisfy arrivalAfterDeparture, and a wrong cohort cannot fill the other cohort's entity/destination map. Both note receipts are conjuncts of o3 and therefore must latch before the later o4 phase.

o4.funding: o4/req-1: once-only 100 wood + 20 gold at destination-4 central workshop.
o4.derivedRequirement: o4/req-2 derives the single qualified-local-timeline-1 from the two named local context notes and the exact o4/req-1 payment receipt.
o4.timelineReceipt: o4/req-3: the timeline arrives at destination-1 western incoming yard.
o4.assessment: The generated object is one explicitly fictional, funded timeline, not a canonical historical document.

survivalAndPresence.survivorGroups: Three western household IDs, three eastern household IDs, each of the two local notes, and the timeline each have alive-or-already-safe minimum equal to their full declared count.
survivalAndPresence.currentResidenceAssessment: No terminal-time residence check is present. Later household arrival history is distinct from asserting that the households remain at an earlier host. The ordered-departure requirements do verify sequence and subsequent arrival, not indefinite residence.

staticBudget.assessment: Static accessible balances exactly match mandatory costs plus protected recovery stock, replacement budget, and declared supply margins at all three levels. This validates arithmetic only, not native access or fun/playability.

projection.result: All six stored hub centers exactly match tile_point(bbox, hub.lonLat, 400) at stored two-decimal precision.

nearestActors: western-original-households-1/2/3 and eastern-original-households-1/2/3 adjacent cohort members
entitiesAndZones.actorCollisionLimit: No entity footprint/radius or native placement collision model is declared; 2-tile center spacing is a coordinate result, not a no-collision guarantee.

sameCenterOptionalZones.note: Distinct optional ledgers share one exact central receiving disk.
Distinct optional ledgers share one exact southwestern target disk.

entitiesAndZones.zoneAssessment: The coincident circles are separate objective-world ledgers. No entity centers coincide; the nearest entity-to-any-zone edge clearance is 3.32 tiles. The shared receiving locations may be intentional; this is flagged for review rather than declared a defect.

corridors.assessment: Frame check only; straight polyline does not certify land traversal.

mapPlanLists: ne-odyssey-coastline: modern regional shoreline control, not ancient harbor geometry
regional-rivers_lake_centerlines: modern controls where available; minor channels and ancient courses need separate evidence
waterAndVisualMap.distanceToDisplayedWater: Not measurable: no blue geographic-control line is rendered in this SVG.
waterAndVisualMap.inspection: Rendered the SVG; it shows six hub circles, five proposed dashed land polylines, a blank uniform terrain square, and a legend. No water line, terrain raster, or optional entities/zones are shown. The legend and labels are inside the viewBox; none is clipped.
waterAndVisualMap.limit: Missing visible control lines do not establish dry land, ancient shoreline, or traversability.

textReview.mainGoalAssessment: Current bilingual o2/o3/o4 objective strings make the per-host resource shares, cohort order, separate note receipts, funded timeline, and retrospective-not-original distinction clear.
textReview.formatting: No comma-number spacing defects or visible internal entity IDs were found in current screen strings.
textReview.secondaryActorSeparation: Guide, household aid actors, and voluntary wayfarers use separate authored identity records and coordinates; no exact center collision was found. Cohort actors are 2 tiles apart at closest centers, as recorded above.
textReview.historicalAndNativeStatus: This text audit does not validate historical claims, certify map locations, or assert game QA/native support.

architectFollowUp.author: gpt-6
architectFollowUp.decision: Keep the two shared receiving work areas, with identity-disjoint predicates and independent once-only ledgers. Actual actors have distinct centers. Tight original-household spacing and all building/unit footprints still require calibrated native placement. No ancestor arrival, wrong-cohort receipt or unproduced timeline may substitute for the explicit causal chain.
